hook: In space, your closed eyes still see flashes.
title: In Space, Closed Eyes Still See Flashes
description:
Astronauts have reported streaks and sparks of light with their eyes shut. These flashes are linked to cosmic rays hitting the eye. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #Space #IfYouWereInSpace
comment_prompt: Would you go to space? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Even in total darkness, eyes shut.
